name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset
description:
Reads, searches, edits, and compiles the Verse source of the open UEFN project. File tools act on
.verse files addressed by their Verse path (e.g. `/<project>/Sub/Foo.verse`). That root is project-
specific -- it is not `/Game` -- so pass `""` to address the root itself, and build paths from the ones
the listing and search tools return. Read-only verse digests are accessible through `/<VRI> (Name)`.

tools.description: Create, overwrite, or edit a region of a .verse file.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.WriteFile

content.description: Text to write; empty deletes the target region (or empties the file). No separator is inserted around the written region, so include a leading "\n" when starting a new line.

span.description: What to write. Unset overwrites the whole file. A span replaces that region of an existing file; a zero-width span inserts without replacing (an end-of-file span therefore appends).
span.title: VerseToolsetSourceSpan

bCreateIfMissing.description: Create the file (and parent directories) when it does not exist. Applies to a whole-file write or an end-of-file append, not to a region replace.

tools.description: Replace OldString with NewString in a .verse file.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.Replace

bReplaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence. When false, OldString must occur exactly once.

span.description: Region to read. Unset reads the whole file. Out-of-range positions are clamped.
span.title: VerseToolsetSourceSpan

returnValue.description: The file's text, or the text within Span when one is given.

tools.description: Move/rename a .verse file, or a directory whose subtree contains only .verse files.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.Move

sourcePath.description: Source path. A file source (and its dest) must be a .verse file; a directory source's subtree must contain no non-.verse file.

destPath.description: Destination; must not already exist; parent must exist; may not be inside a directory source.

tools.description: List a directory's .verse files and subdirectories (other files are omitted).
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.ListFiles

path.description: Directory path to list. An empty path ("") lists the project's own top-level Verse package plus the read-only generated digest packages it depends on, each as a directory entry.

pattern.description: Text to find. A literal substring, matched case-insensitively — unless it is wrapped in '/' (e.g. "/foo.*bar/"), in which case the text between the slashes is a per-line, case-sensitive regular expression (use an inline "(?i)" for case-insensitive regex).

pathGlob.description: Glob restricting which files are searched ("" = every .verse file ListFiles can reach). '*' and '?' match within a single path segment; a '**' segment matches across directories. A bare "*" will not match anything as there are no top-level files; lead with a '**' segment to match .verse files at any depth.

maxResults.description: Maximum matches to return; unset means unlimited.

filePath.description: Path to the file the match was found in.

span.title: VerseToolsetSourceSpan
span.description:
Span of the matched substring. Matches are single-line, so StartLine == EndLine and the span
is [StartCharacter, EndCharacter) on that line.

lineText.description: Full text of the matching line.

returnValue.description: One match per matching line, in file then line order.

tools.description: Delete a .verse file, or a directory whose subtree contains only .verse files.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.Delete

path.description: Path to delete. A file path must be a .verse file; a directory's subtree must contain no non-.verse file. The workspace root is rejected.

tools.description: Create a directory, including any missing parent directories.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.CreateDirectory

tools.description: Copy a .verse file, or a directory whose subtree contains only .verse files.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.Copy

sourcePath.description: Source path. A file source (and its dest) must be a .verse file; a directory source's subtree must contain no non-.verse file.

destPath.description: Destination; must not already exist; parent must exist; may not be inside a directory source.

bRecursive.description: Required (true) when the source is a directory.

tools.description: Compile all Verse code in the project.
tools.name: ValkyrieToolset.VerseToolset.BuildAll

filePath.description: Path to the file the diagnostic refers too, as a virtual Verse path (a compiler path outside the project is reported as-is).

span.title: VerseToolsetSourceSpan
span.description: Source span of the diagnostic within FilePath.

returnValue.description: The build diagnostics; no Error-severity entry means the build succeeded.
